definition: Prospective interventional trial in adults with high-grade glioma (WHO grade 3 or 4, including glioblastoma); phase II, IIa, I/II or Ib/II; no randomised comparison with a control treatment; primary report of results including overall survival; full text in PubMed Central; published 2015 to 2025
coded positive when: All criteria met on full-text assessment
notes: Interim and first-stage reports were eligible; peer review was not required (one preprint included); randomisation between dosing schedules of the same investigational treatment was permitted; several reports of one trial were collated and counted once

definition: Number of patients enrolled; where enrolment was not stated, the number registered, treated or evaluable as reported
notes: The definition used is recorded for every trial

definition: Endpoint designated as primary; for phase I/II designs, the primary endpoint of the phase II component
coded positive when: Categories: overall survival or OS rate; progression-free survival or PFS rate; response or disease control; safety or feasibility; not identified in text

definition: Efficacy compared with historical or published outcome data
coded positive when: The design hypothesis or efficacy threshold is explicitly derived from historical or published data, or the efficacy conclusion explicitly rests on comparison with historical controls or standard-therapy outcomes
notes: General statements that results are consistent with earlier studies of the same agent were not counted

definition: Comparison with an identified cohort of individual patients not enrolled in the trial
coded positive when: Outcomes compared with such a cohort (matched or unmatched)

definition: Number of patients who discontinued study treatment, or were withdrawn from the study, because of adverse events or toxicity
notes: Measure recorded in order of preference: all study treatment; investigational agent; withdrawal from study. Component-specific counts without a total are recorded as reported but not determinable. A single narrative case without a stated total was not counted

definition: Statement on survival follow-up of patients who stopped protocol treatment
coded positive when: The report states that survival follow-up continued after treatment discontinuation, or that all (surviving) patients were followed for survival irrespective of treatment status
notes: Statements limited to follow-up after progression are recorded separately as after progression only

definition: Number of patients lost to follow-up or withdrawn from the study or consent
coded positive when: A number is stated, including a statement of complete follow-up

definition: How lost or withdrawn patients were treated in the analysis
coded positive when: The report states the censoring date, exclusion or imputation used for lost or withdrawn patients
notes: Generic censoring rules for patients alive at analysis are recorded separately and not counted

definition: Analysis varying the assumption that censoring is non-informative
Abstract, body text, tables and figure captions of the main article
coded positive when: Every positive code, sample size and primary endpoint is supported by a verbatim quote in review_evidence.csv, checked by string matching against the source text
notes: Absence was coded after searching for the terms listed in 01_search_screen.py and the broader terms in the extraction protocol; supplementary files and image-only diagrams were not coded
